_doc: Every preset name Fichero has ever shipped. A preset's id is uuid5(namespace, name), so RENAMING a preset mints a new row and strands the old one in every existing library — the user sees two presets forever. The only thing that has ever prevented that is the discipline of adding the old name to _DEPRECATED_PRESET_NAMES in default_workflows.py, which retires the stale row on the next library open. This ledger makes the discipline structural: test_preset_names_never_stranded.py asserts every name here is either currently shipped or explicitly retired, and that every shipped name is here. Add a preset -> add its name here. Rename or remove one -> the old name stays here AND goes into _DEPRECATED_PRESET_NAMES. Never delete a name from this file: a name that leaves the ledger is a name whose stranded rows nothing will ever clean up.
